settings-input-label.note: Documented variant (ADR-161 task 7 probe, 2026-09-13): fixed 24-col width (min 12), height 1, panel background, primary-text color -- the settings grid-row label column. NOT equivalent to form-label (auto width, muted, margin-top 1); do not force-merge. Compounds (#settings-library-rag-card width 20, .settings-imagegen-backend-row width 12, stacked rows width 100%) compose on top. ADR-161 task 10: owning sheet moved components/_agentic_terminal.tcss -> features/_settings.tcss with the settings vocabulary carve; still bundle-resident (the settings split's pinned token -- composed by personas_policy_rules_editor.py app-wide), so its rule rides the boot bundle, not the lazy settings screen sheet.

settings-compact-input.note: Documented variant (ADR-161 task 9 probe, 2026-09-13): the one-row editable field with the task-1586 left-edge control convention (TASK-13154.1: border suppression is what lets the single row paint text; form-input's full border would spend the row on chrome). NOT equivalent to form-input (11 computed-property diffs). Moved tokenized from components/_agentic_terminal.tcss: composed on TWO surfaces (Settings panels + the pattern gallery), so it rides the boot bundle instead of the lazy settings screen sheet (AGENTIC_SPLIT_PINNED_TOKENS rationale). Scoped compounds (#settings-web-search-panel .settings-compact-input, .settings-speech-path-control .settings-compact-input) stay with the Settings surface.

settings-detail-row.note: Documented variant (ADR-161 task 9 probe, 2026-09-13): the read-only detail line (panel fill, primary text, one-row minimum, padding 0 1) vs form-row's auto-height unstyled row (5 computed-property diffs). Moved tokenized from components/_agentic_terminal.tcss: consumed on TWO production surfaces (Settings workbench + the STTS speech settings pane via SpeechSettingsPane), so it rides the boot bundle -- previously it lived on the lazily-loaded settings screen sheet, leaving STTS rows unstyled until Settings was first visited (the exact AGENTIC_SPLIT_PINNED_TOKENS trap; fixed by the move). #settings-impact-pane .settings-detail-row stays with the Settings surface.

settings-status-row.note: ADR-161 task 9 probe: genuinely different from the forms family (inspector fill, muted text, padding 0 1, one-row min). Settings-screen-only -- landed in features/_settings.tcss with the ADR-161 task-10 carve.

settings-compact-select.note: ADR-161 task 9 probe: genuinely different from form-select (grid-line border, inspector fill, 1fr width, SelectCurrent/SelectOverlay shape rules). Settings-screen-only -- landed in features/_settings.tcss with the ADR-161 task-10 carve.

settings-focus-card.note: ADR-161 task 9 probe: genuinely different from the forms family (bordered panel card, padding 0 1, bottom margin 1). Settings-screen-only -- landed in features/_settings.tcss with the ADR-161 task-10 carve.
